_note: opening[] is the rim quad per direction row, in px offsets from the pivot — the polygon a shellfish heap is clipped to. carryGrip is the roller grip; it is the SAME point at every facing because it projects (0,0,GZ), dead centre, and a turn about the vertical axis cannot move it.
_heapNote: every band with a non-zero fraction is baked as Hod2_heap_<band>, one 8-row sheet each, on THIS cell and pivot: draw back, then the band's heap, then front. 'empty' heaps nothing and has no sheet.
